associations.rationale: The formal type directly expresses each character value as a sum of roots of unity, providing the displayed cyclotomic-value statement.
The formal type directly states that a ring homomorphism acting by j-th powers on roots sends chi(g) to chi(g^j).
The formal type directly states that the relevant product of character values at g and g inverse is fixed by the ring homomorphism, matching the beta-fixing part.
